notes.title: New Feature
notes.content: Added a setting to adjust the size of the timer UI

notes.title: Bug Fixed
notes.content:
Fixed the issue where focus time records were calculated incorrectly at midnight span.
Fixed the issue where the Import Music achievement could not be unlocked when importing music.

notes.title: Added new features
notes.content:
New Feature: Add custom music library.

New Furniture: Two new pieces of furniture have been added.

Fixed a bug where paused music would play when interrupting focus.

notes.title: Added new features
notes.content:
Added the setting of whether to automatically hide the player.

Added the ability to add custom background images.
